rationale: The agent did not clearly authenticate the user before acting, did not confirm with the user prior to performing an order-changing write, and did not complete the user’s core request. Although it fetched details for three orders, it only modified the shipping address for one order (#W1845024) without explicit confirmation and without first determining or stating whether partial cancellation was possible. The user requested either partial cancellation of office items with a refund total to the original payment method or, if not possible, changing the address for the shipment(s). The agent provided no calculation or confirmation of the refund amount, did not process or confirm any cancellations, and did not update all relevant orders’ addresses if partial cancellation was not possible. The final message offered no outcomes or policy-aligned confirmations. These issues violate the policy (confirmation before writes, complete and correct execution, and accurate final information).
